lines.x: Protests over wages affected 317 factories in Bangladesh, incurring $428 million in sector losses and shifting $254 million in apparel orders to competing foreign countries.
Bangladesh deployed extra paramilitary forces following arson attacks on political leaders' homes, police stations, and local financial institutions across the country.
The BGMEA says labour unrest cost 317 RMG factories Tk8,184 crore in lost production and orders.
US firms are lining up investment proposals as a US International Development Finance Corporation delegation plans a January visit to Bangladesh.
